verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gazebo can run headless as a server-only process, including in CI environments, and can launch programs and plugins from a configuration script. Neither is a documented feature for defining automations that run on their own in the background, such as recurring schedules, triggers, or background jobs. Headless execution is an adjacent capability, and custom plugins are developer building blocks, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
